passives.name: You Stand Before the Queen
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If none of Glicys's underlings are present, reduces the damage Glicys receives by [Buff_V_4076001_11_2]. At the start of turn, inflicts reduced Speed and Frozenfor [Buff_T_4076001_12_1_1] turn(s) on Fire and Water enemies. If Glicys is hit with a single-target attack while an underling is present, recovers [Buff_V_4076001_11_3] Weakness Gauge after being attacked. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Earth enemies by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt to them, and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them.
